decisions.statement: The group of readings served is the one thing named here.
The readouts the group has are read off the readout pages.
A readout's label is read off that readout's page.
A readout's scale is read off that readout's page.
A reading's color is the rung that reading reaches on the scale.
A readout joining the group reaches the tile without this route changing.
A readout with no fresh reading answers a stoplight with no figure.
`readingHeld` names whether no reading was ever taken or the reading taken went stale.
The tile keeps its full count of six rings where no reading has come in yet.
An empty figure names a missing reading.
The color never names a missing reading.
Only a group no readout is left in answers 503.
The widget reads a 503 as no signal.

definition: Alan's upkeep as the colors its readings reach
